title: Is AI a Bubble? The $1.4 Trillion Bet
alts: AI Bubble Explained: Big Tech's $725 Billion Bet
Is AI the Next Dot-Com Crash? (Circular Money Explained)
line1: Is AI a bubble? Big Tech plans ~$725B of AI spending this year and OpenAI promised $1.4 trillion. Here's what happens if it pops.
summary: Dave's friend Tyler quits his job to put all his savings into AI stocks, so Dave digs into whether AI is a bubble. We cover what a bubble really is, tulip mania in 1637, the dot-com crash (Nasdaq -78%, Pets.com), Big Tech's 2026 data center spending, OpenAI's $1.4 trillion in commitments vs about $40 billion a year in revenue, Nvidia and OpenAI's circular money, the bull case vs the bear case, and what an AI crash would mean for regular people's retirement and jobs.
